question: A sum of ₹800 amounts to Rs. 1,040 in 3 years at simple interest. If the interest rate is increased by 3%, find the amount.
solution:
**Given:**

Principal (P) = ₹800

Amount (A) = ₹1,040

Time (T) = 3 years

Interest Rate increase = 3%

**Formula Used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = P×R×T100" id="MathJax-Element-5-Frame" role="presentation" style="position: relative;" tabindex="0">P×R×T100P×R×T100" id="MathJax-Element-51-Frame" role="presentation" style="position: relative;" tabindex="0">P×R×T100P×R×T100" id="MathJax-Element-13-Frame" role="presentation" style="position: relative;" tabindex="0">P×R×T100P×R×T100" id="MathJax-Element-119-Frame" role="presentation" style="position: relative;" tabindex="0">P×R×T100P×R×T100" id="MathJax-Element-27-Frame" role="presentation" style="position: relative;" tabindex="0">P×R×T100P×R×T100 P×R×T100 P×R×T100 P×R×T100 P×R×T100 \frac{P \times R \times T}{100}
